svg.title: Personal portfolio. A Next.js portfolio with Anime.js motion design, exported to GitHub Pages.
svg.desc: A server-first portfolio built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Anime.js powers the motion design; a static export runs on GitHub Pages. Technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Anime.js. Open project.
